data.name: Esmail
data.gender_notes: Esmail is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Esmail means 'Message Bearer' or 'Carrier of the Message'. This name holds great significance in Islamic history as it is mentioned in the Quran as the name of a messenger who conveyed the message of God to his people. It is a name of spiritual and symbolic importance, representing the idea of carrying and spreading God's message.
data.etymology: Esmail belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Message Bearer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Esmail total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: إسماعيل
in_arabic.meaning: إسماعيل يعني الله يسمع و هو من أسماء النبي إسماعيل عليه السلام
in_arabic.long_meaning: إسماعيل هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه: الله يسمع، سمعه الله، ومن أسماء النبي إسماعيل عليه السلام، وهو ابن النبي إبراهيم عليه السلام، ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سورة البقرة و سورة آل عمران و سورة مريم

in_urdu.name: اسماعیل
in_urdu.meaning: اسماعیل کا مطلب ہے اللہ سنتا ہے، نبی اسماعیل علیه السلام کا نام
in_urdu.long_meaning: اسماعیل ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے، اس کا مطلب ہے اللہ سنتا ہے یا سنا ہوا، یہ نام نبی اسماعیل علیه السلام کے لئے استعمال کیا جاتا ہے جو نبی ابراہیم علیه السلام کے فرزند تھے، اسماعیل کا ذکر قرآن مجید میں سورة البقرة، سورة آل عمران، اور سورة مریم میں کیا گیا ہے

The name Esmail signifies a strong spiritual connection and is widely used in Muslim cultures

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Kathir's Al-Bidayah wa Al-Nihayah, Chapter: The Caliphs After 'Umar Ibn Al-Khattab The name Esmail carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Esmail ibn Ma'adh was one of the first converts to Islam and a companion of the Prophet Muhammad. He was a prince of the Khazraj tribe of Medina. When Esmail's father Ma'adh died, Esmail succeeded him as ruler of the Khazraj. He is known for his bravery and his support for Islam. He died in the battle of Hunayn (630 AD) and was buried in Jannat Al-Baqi' (the graveyard of Medina).

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Sa'd's Tabaqat Al-Kubra, Book 1, Chapter 1 The name Esmail carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Esmail ibn Hudhafa was a prominent companion of the Prophet Muhammad, belonging to the Ansar (Helpers) of Medina. He was known for his generosity and piety. Esmail is mentioned in several Hadiths (sayings of the Prophet Muhammad) and was one of the first forty persons to be admitted into Paradise. He died in the year 661 AD, during the reign of Caliph 'Ali ibn Abi Talib.
